title: Sunday Daily Practice
subtitle: I2 · The Man-made Environment: key words, short answers, Task 1 introduction and voice note
source: Intermediate I2 handout (Lesson 2, Mindset Level 2 Unit 1, Antilia and Writing Task 1 introduction)
intro: Sunday morning class. Work through 4 steps, about 40 minutes. Deadline 00:00 tonight (that is 00:00 Monday). The writing step is marked by AI right after you submit, and you can edit and resubmit. The last step is a voice note; AI will comment on your pronunciation right after you submit.

steps.title: Step 1 · Key words
steps.instructions: Fill in the suitable words or phrases in the gaps. Change the word form if needed.

items.label: The house is very expensive and luxurious. It is ____.
He received the land when his mother died. He ____ the land from her.
items.explain: Inherit (sth) from sb: thừa kế cái gì từ ai.

items.label: The money needed to keep the house in good condition was huge. The ____ were too high.
The family gave the castle to the state for free. They ____ the castle to the state.
The house was built to make visitors feel welcome. The house was built to ____ guests.

steps.title: Step 2 · Reading: NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
steps.instructions: Read the question, find the keywords in the passage about Antilia, then fill in the answer with NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS and/or a number. Copy the exact words from the passage. If you get a word count wrong, note it in your error log.
steps.passage_source: handout I2, Lesson 2 (đoạn Antilia, Mindset Level 2 Unit 1)

items.label: How many lifts does the home have? ____
items.explain: Câu trả lời là số lượng + danh từ: nine lifts (2 từ). Không viết cả câu nine lifts in the lobby (5 từ).

items.label: There are many facilities to accommodate a large number of ____.
items.explain: Đoạn văn paraphrase: designed to entertain guests. Đáp án là guests, không phải visitors.

steps.title: Step 3 · Writing Task 1: Introduction
steps.instructions: The column chart shows the percentage of people aged 25 to 34 in England who lived in their own home (home owners) or rented (renters) from 2004 to 2014. Write a 2–3 sentence Introduction: paraphrase the task, do not copy it word for word, and do not include figures. Type directly into the box below, then press Send for AI marking.

open.model: The given bar chart illustrates the proportion of people aged 25 to 34 in the UK who owned or rented their homes over a ten-year period, commencing from 2004.

ai.task: The bar chart shows how people aged 25 to 34 in the UK were housed (home owners or renters) from 2004 to 2014, in percent. Write only the Introduction: paraphrase the task, mention what, who, where, when and unit, do not copy the question word for word, and do not include any figures.
criteria: paraphrase đủ 5 phần: what, who, where, when, unit
không chép nguyên văn đề bài
không có số liệu trong Introduction
dùng động từ và cụm từ mô tả biểu đồ đúng (illustrates, proportion of, over a ten-year period)

steps.title: Step 4 · Voice note
steps.instructions: Read aloud the sample Introduction in Step 3 once, then record 1 voice note.
lines: The given bar chart illustrates the proportion of people aged 25 to 34 in the UK who owned or rented their homes over a ten-year period, commencing from 2004.
steps.note: AI sẽ nghe và nhận xét phát âm, trọng âm và nhịp đọc ngay sau khi em nộp bài. Thầy cũng sẽ xem lại.

send_today: Hoàn thành 4 bước trên web. Voice note ở Step 4 sẽ được AI nhận xét ngay khi bấm Nộp bài.
